statement: All weighted positive k-uniform ordered predimension classes satisfy closure restriction/intersection/transitivity, S, Rig, SA, FA and FA-empty.
notes: Every k>=2 and a,b>=1; empty bases included.

statement: All C(k,a,b) satisfy St and Op and are total, hence quasi-filtered.
notes: The long-circle loss is am and the bound s>3(delta(E)+am).

statement: For b<(k-1)a an explicit finite atom W has a<delta(W)<=a|W|/2 and only singleton proper nonempty strong subsets.
notes: Four constructions: cycles, truncated cliques in two ranges, core-petal hypergraphs.

statement: For b<(k-1)a C(k,a,b) is not exact over any nonzero ring; D_W is injective and T1(coker D_W)=R.
notes: Includes C(2,2,1), C(3,3,1); all finite parallel families need not be checked because this named family fails.

statement: For b>=(k-1)a C(k,a,b) is Ramsey and exact over every ring, with extremely amenable limit group; b>=ka gives Delta_inj.
depends_on: D-EHN2021 Theorem 1.3; D-EHN2019 Theorem 2.13; T A.6
notes: At b=(k-1)a components have unbounded finite size; unary set-valued functions are explicitly allowed.

statement: The ordered limit group is amenable iff extremely amenable iff b>=(k-1)a; unordered low-range groups are nonamenable.
notes: Hall matching and the hyperedge-assignment compact flow prove the negative range directly.

statement: The Cdelta shadow is 2-sparse; general shadow sparsity holds iff b>a(k-2); the unqualified sparse-relation claim EHN Remark 3.2 is false.
notes: Refines Lead 4(a) and confirms Lead 8(c) caveat. Explicit 36-vertex ternary counterexample with K8 shadow.

statement: For b<(k-1)a the ordered limit has no co-precompact extremely amenable subgroup and no precompact strong Ramsey expansion.
notes: Bounded forward balls plus arbitrarily long monotone directed paths whose distant endpoint pairs are strong.

statement: The complete parameter table: no filtered examples; all total/quasi-filtered; exactness over every nonzero ring, Ramsey, and amenability agree with b>=(k-1)a.
notes: No parameter in this family gives a counterexample to A.3(i) or A.3(iv).

statement: The five-edge signed formula in Lead 8(e) works for a>2b; its target is positive iff a>b and all listed edges are closed iff a>2b.
notes: A support in which every vertex occurs exactly twice cannot have affine augmentation; individual triple solvability does not imply exactness.

statement: The unordered Cdelta initial triple is rationally equalizable but the category is not exact over any nonzero ring.
notes: Explicit rigid 18-point 11-triple atom from an asymmetric cubic graph; all subsets and all graph automorphisms checked.

statement: For a Ramsey expansion u:A*->Cdelta the source is exact and u is not homotopy final; the proposed comma-H1 edge-map description of T1(Q_R) is false.
notes: Correct spectral sequence has E2_1,0=T1(u_!F)=0 for all F; Q_R cannot be any u_!F.
